g.text: From the mean matrix M to the flow of the tumor
Two-type reduction: sensitive (S) and resistant (R). The numbers on the left are the arrows on the right.
No therapy: arrows radiate from the origin (composition unchanged). Therapy: every arrow turns toward the R axis.
Arrows = one-generation expected change E[(S',R') | s] − (S,R); shared length scale, no per-arrow normalization.
